Invite-code servers keep each player's own inventory.

## Server

### Fixed
- With `"Transport": "eos"`, the host no longer rewrites a joining player's inventory id. On Solarpunk 1.3.0 players arrive with their own Epic ids and the game keys their records itself; the older inventory stamp matched records by player name, so two players with the same name, or every new player, could end up holding one shared inventory. The direct-IP transport (`"ip"`) is unchanged.

Based on v0.1.91.
